_note: Pierce's autonomy model, enforced in code (src/policy.js) before every outbound message. mode: auto = Level 2, send without asking | approve = Level 3, Pierce must Y | block = never. Start conservative, widen as the bot proves itself. Change this file and redeploy; no code changes needed.
_test_mode: true = nothing external is sent; every message becomes an approval. Pierce turned this OFF on Nov 1 2026 ("you have my Y approval for new leads... while sticking to policies"). Policies below still hold price/terms/legal, sensitive docs, favorites' texts and CSV lists for his Y. Text PAUSE to stop everything.

first_touch.listing_email.why: fresh inquiry on our listing, public info only

first_touch.favorite.why: LoopNet/Crexi 'saved your listing': not an inquiry, so the text waits for Pierce's Y (TCPA). The email goes per first_touch.email.

first_touch.unmatched.why: Pierce (Nov 2 2026): the bot works only his and Dylan's listings. A lead that matches none of them may be another agent's, so the first message waits for his Y.

first_touch.email.why: Pierce (Nov 1 2026): the first email with links goes out automatically 1-2 min after the inquiry. Lands in Outlook Drafts unless EMAIL_SEND_MODE=send.

reply.ca_docs.why: OM / rent roll / financials to a CA-verified buyer

reply.holding.why: 'let me confirm with Pierce' while a question is open

reply.document_link.why: view-only link to a doc the buyer is cleared for

reply.email.why: Pierce (Nov 2 2026): send, don't draft. Email replies follow the same rules as texts; price/terms/legal and sensitive docs still escalate first.

escalate.price_terms_legal.why: Level 3: offers, counters, terms, commission, legal

limits._rate_limits: Pierce, Nov 2 2026: answer every buyer message. Caps are runaway guards: 3 messages the buyer hasn't answered (in 24h), 20 a day in total. A held reply becomes a Y# draft for Pierce.
